scope: One bounded live development case for the existing gas-phase pipeline; not a validation of broad chemical or environmental coverage and not an admitted uncertainty calibration.

preflight_policy.rule: Start cyclobutene only. Any replacement requires a separate condition- and reference-locked preregistration before its preflight; the three-candidate cap is not a request to run three cases.

chemical_system.mechanism_expectation: Thermal conrotatory ring opening, to be independently discovered and verified rather than supplied as a preverified route.

conditions.pressure_conversion_note: 50 Torr converted to bar; the historical source labels pressure in mm Hg. This precision is a unit conversion, not experimental precision.
conditions.model_vs_experiment_caveat: The calculation omits material withdrawal used in the experiment; the first-order rate, rather than a raw closed-batch trajectory, is the primary comparator.

reference.citation: Cooper, W.; Walters, W. D. The Thermal Isomerization of Cyclobutene. J. Am. Chem. Soc. 1958, 80, 4220-4224.
reference.source_location: Printed page 4222, Table II, reaction vessel A, sample II(c), initial pressure 50 mm Hg, first two rows.

transcription.method: Web-indexed text of the primary PDF, including Table II headings and rows.
transcription.caveat: Direct PDF retrieval was unavailable during registration. Verify the source page visually before treating this transcription as an audited experimental reference. Do not silently replace these values if a correction becomes necessary; retain a dated amendment before scoring.

reference.rate_convention: First-order rate inferred by the authors from butadiene formation; Table II reports 10^4 k with k in s^-1.

primary_numeric_comparator.definition: Arithmetic mean of the two registered rows; a fixed scoring comparator, not an additional measurement or fitted calibration.

derived_comparators.assumption: Irreversible first-order parent loss using the registered midpoint rate, not an independently measured lifetime or trajectory.

reference.pressure_applicability: The source reports approximately pressure-independent first-order rates from 5 to 50 mm Hg at 150 C and falloff at lower pressures. This does not validate an arbitrary-pressure extension.
experimental_caveats: Successive sampling ordinarily reduced pressure by about 3% per interval.
Sample II(c) was treated with anhydrous CuSO4 before reaction, not simulated as a CuSO4-containing reaction environment.
Unknown systematic and total experimental uncertainties are not zero.

accuracy.meaning: Development accuracy criterion only; neither an uncertainty distribution nor evidence for a calibrated confidence interval.

mechanism: Independently discover a route from cyclobutene to 1,3-butadiene and preserve competing discovered candidates.
Validate endpoints, a meaningful first-order saddle, and both IRC connections under the production verification contract.
Use the resulting elementary rate in repaired-network propagation with auditable provenance; reference agreement alone does not validate a mechanism.
The dominant propagated parent-loss product must be 1,3-butadiene for the declared conditions.

fresh_vs_controlled_resume.comparison_rule: For each finite nonzero observable, abs(resumed-fresh)/abs(fresh) <= 0.01; zeros and censored values require matching status and explicit handling, not division by zero.
fresh_vs_controlled_resume.interruption: Controlled interruption at a recorded route checkpoint, followed by resume under unchanged scientific inputs.
fresh_vs_controlled_resume.artifact_identity: Reused completed artifacts retain their hashes. Independently fresh numerical calculations need not be bit-identical.

applicability_review.expected_discovery_family: Intra_2+2_cycloaddition_Cd (reverse Four_Ring_Open), present in the installed RMG default families; actual candidate extraction remains to be tested.
applicability_review.expected_existing_rate_lane: One-reactant/one-product barriered canonical TST; the near-pressure-independent source regime motivates this local approximation, not universal pressure independence.
preflight_must_confirm: The actual production discovery input generates the expected candidate without manual route injection.
The parent and product survive identity mapping and endpoint generation.
The method selector does not admit the case by silently suppressing a detected applicability concern.
unresolved_physical_risks: Electronic-structure barrier error is not calibrated by selecting this reference case.
Heavy-atom tunneling and anharmonic effects cannot be presumed negligible at the requested temperature.
Product conformers, reaction-path degeneracy, rotational symmetry and any recrossing approximation require correct treatment.
Bounded discovery is not proof of complete mechanism coverage.
A validated IRC connection is not proof of single-reference electronic-structure accuracy.

independent_theory_source.citation: Mandelli, G.; Aieta, C.; Ceotto, M. Heavy Atom Tunneling in Organic Reactions at Coupled Cluster Potential Accuracy with a Parallel Implementation of Anharmonic Constant Calculations and Semiclassical Transition State Theory. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2022, 18, 623-637.
independent_theory_source.relevance: Cyclobutene calculations compare electronic-structure and rate theories and expose tunneling and anharmonic sensitivity.
independent_theory_source.non_transferability: B3LYP/6-31G*, MP2 and coupled-cluster results are not a condition-matched total-error calibration of STORCA B3LYP/def2-SVP plus its actual statistical-mechanical treatment.

uncertainty_evidence_review.rule: Use this literature as an applicability warning and a possible independent model comparison, not an invented confidence bound. Any future uncertainty record requires separately justified method, condition, component and provenance coverage; do not fit it to this development case's experimental rate.

completion_requirements: Retain all bounded RMG attempts and their resource and termination evidence.
Retain real endpoint, path, saddle, frequency, IRC, rate-generation and repaired-propagation evidence.
Record actual method profiles, versions, budgets, conditions and deterministic input identities.
Score the registered comparator and fresh/resume agreement without moving their thresholds after observing predictions.
Separate an engineering pass, central-rate accuracy pass and scientifically defensible conditional prediction; none implies the others.
If applicability, coverage, uncertainty or reference auditing remains unresolved, preserve that status and do not claim the P1 scientific gate has passed.
